    What is a Custom Exhibition Stand?

    A custom exhibition stand is a bespoke, one-of-a-kind structure designed and built from the ground up to meet the unique marketing objectives of a single brand. Unlike pre-fabricated or modular systems, a custom stand offers complete creative freedom in terms of layout, materials, technology, and overall aesthetic. It is a powerful statement of brand identity, designed to attract maximum attention, facilitate meaningful interactions, and create a memorable visitor journey in a competitive exhibition environment. As a leading provider of custom exhibition stands in Dubai , FANN transforms your vision into a physical reality that commands the show floor.

    Get a Free Quote

    Our Custom Design Process: From Vision to Reality

    Our process is a collaborative journey designed to ensure your final stand is a perfect reflection of your brand and goals. It is meticulously managed by our expert team, providing you with clarity and confidence at every stage.

  • Discovery & Briefing: We start by understanding your brand, objectives, target audience, and budget. This deep dive ensures our creative direction is strategically aligned with your desired outcomes.
  • Conceptual Design & 3D Visualization: Our designers develop initial concepts and translate them into photorealistic 3D renders. You'll see exactly how your stand will look, feel, and function on the exhibition floor.
  • Revisions & Refinement: We collaborate with your team, incorporating feedback to refine every detail of the design, from material finishes to visitor flow, until it's perfect.
  • Technical Drawings & Fabrication: Once approved, we move to detailed technical drawings. Our in-house fabrication team then begins construction in our state-of-the-art Dubai workshop.
    • fabrication team
  • On-Site Installation & Handover: Our dedicated project managers oversee the entire installation process at the venue, ensuring a flawless build that's ready for you to impress your visitors.

    • [Infographic: Our 5-Step Custom Design Process]

    In a globally competitive market like Dubai, standing out is not just an option—it's a necessity. A bespoke stand from FANN offers significant advantages:

  • Unmatched Brand Impact: A unique design ensures your brand is not just seen, but remembered long after the event.
  • Tailored Functionality: Every element is designed around your specific needs, whether it's for product demos, private meetings, or VIP hospitality.
  • Superior Visitor Engagement: Create immersive experiences with integrated technology and a layout designed to guide visitors and encourage interaction.
  • Flexibility in Design: From double-decker structures to complex lighting rigs, the only limit is your imagination. This is crucial for major events like GITEX Global .
    • GITEX Global
  • Perceived Market Leadership: A significant, high-quality custom stand signals to competitors and clients that you are a serious player in your industry.

  • Healthcare & Pharma: Designing clean, professional, and compliant stands for Arab Health.
  • Real Estate & Construction: Building large-scale, luxurious pavilions for Cityscape and The Big 5.
  • Food & Beverage: Crafting elegant and functional spaces with hospitality features for Gulfood.
  • Aviation & Defence: Engineering secure, high-impact exhibits for the Dubai Airshow and IDEX.

Modular Exhibition Systems for Dubai & UAE Events

Flexible, sustainable, and cost-effective solutions for the modern exhibitor. Maximize your impact across multiple events with a single, scalable system.

    What Are Modular Exhibition Systems?

    Modular exhibition systems are a sophisticated and versatile alternative to traditional custom builds. They are composed of standardized, interlocking components—such as aluminum frames, connectors, and panels—that can be assembled in a multitude of configurations. This 'building block' approach allows for the creation of stands that are not only reusable but also adaptable to different space requirements and layouts. At FANN, we leverage cutting-edge modular systems to provide our clients with high-impact, brand-centric stands that offer unparalleled flexibility and long-term value.

    Get a Quote for a Modular System

    The Advantages of Modular Stands

    Choosing a modular exhibition stand offers a range of strategic benefits, particularly for companies with a consistent event calendar:

  • Cost-Effectiveness: The primary benefit is the reduction in long-term costs. By reusing the core structure, you save significantly on fabrication expenses for each subsequent show.
  • Sustainability: Reusability inherently makes modular stands a more eco-friendly option, reducing waste and aligning with corporate sustainability goals.
  • Scalability & Flexibility: A single system can be reconfigured to fit a 12sqm inline booth at one show and a 50sqm island space at another, making it a highly adaptable investment.
  • Faster Turnaround: With pre-engineered components, both the design and on-site installation processes are considerably faster than a full custom build.
  • Consistency: Maintain a consistent, high-quality brand image across all your events, regardless of the location or booth size.

    • Our Modular System Options

    We don't believe in a one-size-fits-all approach. FANN provides a curated selection of world-class modular systems to suit different aesthetic and functional needs:

  • Frame-Based Systems: These versatile aluminum systems (similar to Octanorm or Maxima) provide a robust structure for mounting graphics, screens, and shelving.
  • Tension Fabric Systems: Lightweight frames are covered with large, seamless, high-resolution fabric graphics, creating a clean, modern, and visually stunning look.
  • Hybrid Solutions: We often create the most impactful designs by combining the efficiency of modular systems with bespoke, custom-built elements. This could mean a modular framework enhanced with a custom reception counter, unique product displays, or high-end flooring. This approach, which is a FANN specialty, balances budget with brand impact.

    • Beyond the Frame: Customization & Branding

    A modular stand from FANN is never generic. We transform the system into a powerful branding tool through expert customization. Our in-house production capabilities allow us to integrate:

  • High-Impact Graphics: We print vibrant, high-resolution graphics on various materials, including tension fabrics and rigid panels, which can be easily swapped out for different events or campaigns.
  • Advanced Lighting: From backlit fabric walls to programmable LED accents and professional spotlights, we use lighting to create mood and highlight key areas.
  • Technology Integration: Seamlessly incorporate LED screens, touch panels, and charging stations directly into the modular structure.
  • Custom Furniture & Finishes: We pair the system with carefully selected furniture and flooring to complete the desired aesthetic, whether it's for a corporate lounge or a dynamic product showcase.

    • This level of customization ensures your reusable exhibition stand always looks fresh, relevant, and perfectly aligned with your brand. Explore our portfolio for inspiration.

    FANN is a Dubai design and build company. We deliver commercial fit-outs across Dubai and Abu Dhabi with one accountable team and our own joinery workshop - from first drawing to final finish.

    Get an itemised quote

    What we deliver

  • Partitioning
  • Ceilings
  • Flooring
  • Custom joinery and panelling
  • MEP coordination
  • Final finishes

    • Every joinery piece is produced in our own workshop, so quality and lead times stay in our hands.

    Why in-house matters

    Our production facility means no third-party joinery lead times, one consistent specification across every site, and changes turned around in days, not weeks. For operators opening more than one location, that is how every site opens to the same standard.

    Proven on immovable deadlines

    FANN builds exhibition stands and event environments for opening dates that cannot move - including work for Icons of Porsche and ADEK. A store or restaurant opening runs on the same clock. We plan backwards from your opening date and deliver to it.

    Event build: Icons of Porsche 2025, Dubai Design District Exhibition build: National Expression for ADEK, Abu Dhabi Event build: Community Village entrance, Icons of Porsche 2025

    One team, start to finish

    Design, joinery production, site works, MEP coordination and finishing sit with one team. You deal with one accountable partner, not a chain of subcontractors. We handle venue and authority coordination as part of every build.

    How we quote

    Per site, itemised, and fast. Send us drawings or a BOQ and we return a clear scope and quotation without a long tender process.

About FANN

Founded in Dubai in 2019, FANN was born from a passion for transforming visions into tangible, unforgettable realities. As a full-service design and build company, we believe that a well-executed project—from initial concept to final construction—has the power to inspire, connect, and drive success.

Our philosophy is built on a dual commitment: relentless innovation and uncompromising excellence. We merge cutting-edge technology and global design trends with a deep understanding of the regional culture and market. This unique synthesis allows us to deliver experiences that are not only visually stunning but also strategically sound and culturally resonant.

At the heart of FANN is our diverse team of strategists, designers, architects, and project managers. Hailing from across the globe, our experts bring a wealth of international experience to every project, ensuring world-class standards are met with precise local execution. We are more than just designers; we are a complete design and build partner, dedicated to bringing our clients' stories to life with creativity, precision, and expert craftsmanship.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

This policy explains what information FANN collects when you use fann.ae, why we collect it and how you can contact us about it.

What we collect

  • Details you send through our forms: name, email, phone, company, project details and any files or briefs you share.
  • Messages you send to our website chat assistant.
  • Basic usage data collected by analytics and advertising tools (Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics and Meta Pixel), such as pages visited, device type and approximate location.

    • How we use it

  • To reply to your enquiry, prepare quotes and deliver your project.
  • To understand which pages and campaigns work, so we can improve the website and our marketing.
  • We do not sell your personal information.

    • Cookies

    Analytics and advertising tools set cookies in your browser. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings; the site will still work.

    Who we share it with

    Only with service providers that help us run the website and handle enquiries (hosting, email delivery, analytics and advertising platforms), and where the law requires it.

    How long we keep it

    We keep enquiry details for as long as needed to handle your request and any project that follows, and to meet legal and accounting duties.

    Your choices

    You can ask us to see, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you by emailing sales@fann.ae .
